title: CRISPR screening in human hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells reveals an enrichment for tumor suppressor genes within chromosome 7 commonly deleted regions.
authors: Baeten, Jeremy T; Liu, Weihan; Preddy, Isabelle C; Zhou, Ningxuan; McNerney, Megan E
one_liner_zh: 该文用CRISPR筛选和机器学习研究染色体7缺失区肿瘤抑制基因，虽涉及CUX1转录因子但核心是造血增殖与红系分化表型，无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Monosomy 7 and del(7q) are among the most common cytogenetic abnormalities in myeloid malignancies, yet their underlying pathogenesis remains unclear. Using an array-based CRISPR screen and orthogonal machine learning approach, we identify potential chromosome 7 tumor suppressor genes (TSGs). We selected candidate TSGs via datamining of genome-scale studies, individually CRISPR-edited 108 candidates, and measured the subsequent impact on the proliferation and erythroid differentiation of primary, human CD34+ hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs). An unexpected 39% of genes increased proliferation when edited, and were significantly enriched in commonly deleted regions. The only two genes that both increased proliferation and decreased erythroid differentiation when edited were the CUX1 transcription factor and ACHE, encoding acetylcholinesterase, both located in the 7q22.1 commonly deleted region. We demonstrate a novel role for ACHE in regulating erythropoiesis through acetylcholine receptor signaling. The defects stemming from loss of ACHE were corrected by a muscarinic receptor inhibitor, implicating muscarinic antagonists as potential treatments for -7/del(7q)-associated anemia. While chromosome-level deletions were historically thought to harbor a single TSG, the significant enrichment of TSGs within commonly deleted regions suggests a contiguous gene syndrome, wherein combinatorial loss of multiple neighboring genes drives disease.
abstract_zh: 单染色体7和del(7q)是髓系恶性肿瘤中最常见的细胞遗传学异常之一，但其潜在发病机制仍不清楚。通过基于阵列的CRISPR筛选和正交机器学习方法，我们鉴定了潜在的7号染色体肿瘤抑制基因（TSGs）。我们通过对全基因组规模研究的数据挖掘选择候选TSGs，逐一CRISPR编辑了108个候选基因，并测量了其对原代人CD34+造血干祖细胞（HSPCs）增殖和红系分化的后续影响。出乎意料的是，39%的基因在编辑后增加了增殖，并且显著富集于常见缺失区域。唯一两个在编辑后既增加增殖又减少红系分化的基因是CUX1转录因子和ACHE（编码乙酰胆碱酯酶），两者均位于7q22.1常见缺失区域。我们证明了ACHE通过乙酰胆碱受体信号调控红系生成的新作用。ACHE缺失导致的缺陷可通过毒蕈碱受体抑制剂纠正，提示毒蕈碱拮抗剂可能成为-7/del(7q)相关贫血的潜在治疗方法。虽然历史上认为染色体水平缺失仅含有一个TSG，但TSGs在常见缺失区域内的显著富集提示这是一种连续基因综合征，其中多个相邻基因的组合性缺失驱动疾病发生。
